text: Private fund management fees have compressed materially: the historical two percent of commitments has shifted in recent years to roughly 1.0 percent for new managers and 1.5 to 1.8 percent for established managers with an adequate track record.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998033

isBasedOn.name: Blockchain Innovation for Private Investment Funds

abstract: However, the historical fee of 2% of commitments through the reinvestment period, then 2% on the cost basis for the investments/value of fund has shifted in recent years closer to 1.0% for new managers and 1.5-1.8% for established managers with an adequate track record.

value: describes private equity and hedge fund fee practice as of 2016 and 2017
